shortDescription: Ethena Foundation said its fee switch vote has passed with 100% support, allowing programmatic ENA buybacks to begin. According to Foresight News, the buyback program will expand gradually as metrics and milestones are met.

title: Ethena Foundation Approves Fee Switch Vote, Starts Programmatic ENA Buybacks
